structured_output.what_is_happening: "Ronald Sakoosky" ($Sakoos) is a misspelled version of the name of Ronald Sakolsky. He is a retired US teacher whose 1999 donation of $5,000 paid for more than 50,000 trees planted by Inner Mongolian farmer Yin Yuzhen. The two reunited in China in August 2026, Xi Jinping cited the story as proof of people-to-people China-US ties, and Chinese state media covered it heavily until early September (SCMP, CGTN, China Daily). The token's only linked social is one post by @whyyoutouzhele ('Teacher Li', a large Chinese-language dissident news account). That link was lifted from a news account, not a project account. The coin launched on a Meteora virtual curve, migrated to PumpSwap about 45 minutes before T2, and pumped to an ATH price of 0.00152 (about $1.5M mcap). It then fell about 85-90% within 30 minutes (GT m30 -84.5%, DexScreener m5 -78%). At my last check it had bounced to about $0.00018-0.00019 (about $180-190k mcap, $36k liquidity). Volume is about $3.3M in its first hour. That is 100x+ turnover, typical of bot/bundle churn: 53 GMGN bundler wallets, and only 101 unique sellers against 2,100 buyers, which suggests a few large wallets dumped on many small buyers. The creator's status is 'creator_close', meaning the creator has exited.
